content: Operations with numbers in the form of a power of ten where the leading digit is between one and ten.
guidance: Students should be aware that calculator or computer notation is not acceptable in written answers.

entries.label: The sum of an infinite geometric sequence

questions.text: 1. [Maximum mark: 6] A ball is dropped from a height and bounces to a fraction of its previous height each time it lands.
questions.markScheme: recognizing the bounce heights form a geometric sequence with common ratio r (M1) A1

steps: Each bounce reaches a fixed fraction of the height before it (M1)
markedSteps.answer: The total distance is twice the sum of the bounce heights

entries.text: Forgetting that the ball travels both up and down after every single bounce.
